policy: Candidates are selected from the confirmed 1120-page acceptance PDF. They are not HUMAN_VERIFIED Gold pages until page-image hashes, annotations, and reviewer sign-off are recorded. Semantic boundary tags are assigned only from direct page-content inspection, never inferred by the automatic page profiler.

candidates.reason: image-only opening page; exercises scanned/image path
regular text page with embedded image
low native-text density with multiple images
introduction entry begins on page 220 and continues with its example at the top of page 221; directly inspected from source PDF
continuation page for introduction entry from page 220; directly inspected from source PDF
anticipate entry starts at page end and continues on page 458; directly inspected from source PDF
continuation page for anticipate entry from page 457; directly inspected from source PDF
abolish example crosses into page 461; directly inspected from source PDF
contains continuation of abolish from page 460 and sample entry continuing into page 462; directly inspected from source PDF
continues sample entry from page 461 and approaches Word List transition; directly inspected from source PDF
index/reference-style phrase listing selected by full-document profiler

required_before_freeze: render candidate page images and record SHA256
inspect page visuals and finalize layout tags
create ground-truth annotation JSON per page
human reviewer sign-off for all 30 pages
